'''Falyeh Keth''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Gungan/Legends|Gungan]] who served in the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
Keth was born on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]]<ref name="UCD" /> in about [[28 BBY/Legends|28 BBY]]<ref name="Birth date" /> and during his childhood he often listened to stories about the rise if the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]]. He became convinced that the things that the Empire was doing were wrong and over time, he developed a number of technical skills that he believed would be of use to any rebellion that took place against Imperial rule. Following the outbreak of the Galactic Civil War, Keth left Naboo and joined the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="UCD" />

At some point after the [[Destruction of Alderaan/Legends|destruction]] of the planet [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], Keth and a team of Rebel agents were [[Mission to Tazan|dispatched]] by the Alliance to the planet [[Tazan]], to destroy an [[Imperial Data Processing Facility]] that was located on the world. After arriving on Tazan, Keth and the rest of the team rendezvoused with the Alliance sympathizer [[Willer Clines]] in [[Willer Clines' House|Clines' house]], in the [[Desander Section]] of [[Tazan City]]. However, their conversation with Clines was secretly monitored by a group of Imperial [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] and once the stormtroopers believed that Rebels had revealed all that they would about their mission, the stormtroopers entered Clines' lounge and attacked Keth and the rest of the Rebels. The agents escaped and eventually infiltrated the Data Processing Facility, where they extracted some Imperial [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] communications protocols and then blew up the structure.<ref name="UCD" />

==Personality and traits==
Keth's skills and abilities ensured that he was welcomed by his colleagues within the Rebel Alliance. However, he was always looking for an opportunity to prove himself, became he was aware that Gungans were regarded as a bit of a joke by members of some other [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="UCD" />
